Name: Hadad, Prince of Edom
Summary: Hadad, an Edomite prince of the king's seed, fled to Egypt when Joab smote Edom, was given Pharaoh's sister-in-law to wife, and returned to trouble Solomon after David's death.
KeyStory: Hadad flees to Egypt and returns as Solomon's adversary.
RelatedPeople: King Solomon; Tahpenes, Queen of Egypt; Genubath, Son of Hadad
LifeLesson: An old enemy spared becomes a new adversary: mercy without repentance repeats itself.
